items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: I've known him yeah... But he played second with his brother when I was in Chicago

ctx.x: Well yeah they was using second trumpet then but I'm on here You didn't know Ike? I've known him yeah but when I come back he was sick and never no good no more But he played second with his brother when I was in Chicago See I stayed in Chicago for 84 years Oh yeah that's right 84 years 84 years And I played so many good spots there
He was right Was Ike Morgan as good as Sam or better or worse or what? Well that's what I don't know Oh you never knew him huh? To play
